criteria.label: Order translation
criteria.description: Maps all six preferences to valid menu item codes using the supplied glossary.

criteria.label: Ambiguity resolution
criteria.description: Asks for clarification instead of guessing the ambiguous preference.

criteria.label: Unavailable-item substitution
criteria.description: Proposes and confirms an acceptable available alternative.

criteria.label: Price and total verification
criteria.description: Verifies each price and calculates the final total.

criteria.label: Constraint prompting
criteria.description: Provides the menu, dietary, budget, and availability constraints to the AI.

criteria.label: AI error correction
criteria.description: Catches and corrects at least one planted or prompted AI error.

criteria.label: Clear final instruction
criteria.description: Produces a complete final table without unresolved assumptions.
